architectural_contracts: PipelineLLMClient Protocol methods: run_structured_state, repair_structured_state, run_markdown_report (signatures match AnthropicClient exactly; structural subtyping), defined in src/pipeline_client.py
Provider-neutral types CallResult, EncodedImage, PassTelemetry contain NO provider SDK types and are JSON-serialisable; embedded in request_snapshot['telemetry']

OpenAI uses Responses API (client.responses.create, instructions= param); Pass 1 uses Structured Outputs (strict json_schema via text.format), Pass 2 standard text; no stub detection/retry (Claude-specific failure mode)

Two-pass pipeline: Pass 1 -> EmitDailyStateInput (flat) -> flat_to_nested -> DailyState; Post-Pass-1 enforcement applies precomputed numerics before Pass 2; Pass 2 -> 8-section markdown investor report (exposition lock, no titles/fact blocks/matrix/divergence labels in LLM output)
Next.js rewrites /api/* -> FastAPI at 127.0.0.1:8000; FastAPI CORS restricted to localhost:3000 and 127.0.0.1:3000
Daily workflow: `prepare --date` (15 charts + manifest + precompute into data/runs/<date>/) then `run --date` (two-pass analysis); Images/ staging dir is legacy path
Framework version: daily-2026-06; PR docs are the canonical build records in spx-analyst/docs/ (highest: PR-22)

Publication-first web UI: SiteHeader (root layout), / (homepage lead story + stream), /runs/{date} (scrollable article + sticky right rail), /archive (grid), /assistant (chat workspace); field-authority rule prevents DailyState field duplication across header/rail/article
Shadow-run isolation: separate .env.shadow-openai with SPX_OUTPUT_DIR=output/shadow-openai, SPX_INCLUDE_MEMORY=false, SPX_LLM_PROVIDER=openai; no memory injection ensures clean comparison
